pandas.Series.between_time

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Select observations within a clock-time range, independent of their calendar dates.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

Series.between_time(start_time, end_time, inclusive='both', axis=None)

Run the example

Edit the example and select Run Python to see the result.


    

    
Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
start_time
      Required
Positional or keyword		
      datetime.time or str
Set the first clock time considered for a time-of-day selection.


end_time
      Required
Positional or keyword		
      datetime.time or str
Set the last clock time considered for a time-of-day selection.


inclusive
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default 'both'		
      {"both", "neither", "left", "right"}
Choose whether the start, end, both, or neither boundary is included.


axis
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      {0 or 'index', 1 or 'columns'}
Choose which axis the operation acts on. The accepted axis labels depend on the receiver.

    
Returns
Series or DataFrame
